```plato

    //==
    // # ILattice gradients
    //
    // Gradient (Perlin-family) noise needs a unit vector per lattice cell rather
    // than a scalar. Both are drawn from the hash by inverse transform sampling,
    // which is uniform over the circle and over the sphere respectively — the
    // classic 8- and 12-entry gradient tables are an optimization, not the
    // definition, and a table costs a branch chain in a language without arrays
    // of constants.

    // The unit gradient of planar lattice cell (ix, iy): the hash read as an
    // angle.
    LatticeGradient2D(seed: Integer, ix: Integer, iy: Integer): Vector2D {
        var a = HashToUnit(LatticeHash(seed, ix, iy)).Turns;
        return (a.Cos, a.Sin);
    }
```
